setup.baseline: Any game with controllable fleets and production.
setup.variable: One documented ordering constraint at a time.

procedure: Create a minefield and a fleet that both starts in it and moves out; record sweeping.
Move a fleet through a stargate and record arrival year.
Launch a packet at a known distance and record first-year travel and decay.
Run a battle and record round phases and disengagement.
Block a production queue with missing minerals and record later items.

documented: Minesweeping happens before movement, so a fleet sweeps in the year it leaves a field (documented-only).
Stargate travel is fuel-free and completes in the same year (documented-only).
Packets travel half the normal distance in their first year and decay in launch/arrival years (documented-only).
Battles last up to 16 rounds; a round is each token moving and firing, split into token phases (documented-only).
Production is processed top-down and halts if the planet runs out of minerals (documented-only).
Research resources are taken off the top of the resource heap unless Contribute Only Leftover Resources is checked (documented-only).

unresolved: These constraints do not establish their order relative to one another.
The version applicability of each help statement is unverified.
